items.text: fixed: the heads-up display's left and right arrows now count every tap, even while the pane is still sliding (quick taps used to be lost), and they are wider (46 px) with no tap delay.
changed: the calm start (20 bpm, golden split of rows and columns) is only for a first visit. After that the tempo and which rows and columns play are kept, so a reload brings back what you left.
changed: the opening grid uses a golden split: 62% of the rows play and 38% of the columns, or the other way round, chosen at random each load.
changed: a calmer first start. Tempo opens at 20 bpm, and only about four in ten rows and columns play, chosen at random, so the grid is sparse and slow. Everything can still be changed as before.

added: Automation has two new switches. Seed the field (on) drops two or three quiet sounds into the field at random when the robot first starts. Replace field sounds (off) lets one of them fade every few auto rolls while a new one comes in somewhere else. Sounds you place yourself are never replaced.
changed: tapping the welcome screen now also starts the robot, so a first visit plays the score straight away.
added: the colophon now has an AI:RATIO block, laid out as in Current. It is blank for now (not yet scored); the 100% non-AI-in-use line, the foundations note and the disclosure are filled in.

changed: on a large desktop screen (1500 px wide and up) the tempo bar is as wide as the pop-up panels, centred, with scenes and undo on its left and record, share and the rest on its right. On a very wide screen (a 4K or 5K monitor) the panels and the tempo bar grow together, up to 1400 px, so the slider is longer to drag. Laptops keep the size they have.
